name: Restart PS5
description: Open the PS5 Control Center Power menu and select Restart. Check the Power icon focus in step mode before first use.
notes: PS5 only. Control Center remembers its last icon and icon layout varies. This legacy macro needs its right-tap count calibrated to the console before running; it is not a universal restart command. Restart disconnects Remote Play. Do not append further input commands to this script.
script:
ps
wait 800
down
wait 400
right 10x
wait 400
cross
wait 400
down 2x
wait 400
cross
author: P5 Manager
